rationale: Eight frozen candidates have YES in all five viability dimensions. They preserve household-specific explanatory inquiry, continuity-based attribution, and material documentation and classification constraints. K03 has no NO dimension and one UNCERTAIN; its uncertainty does not defeat the definite survivors. Meaningful scope is lost through deletion of the intervention-selection, causal-comparison, retain-or-revert and purchasing-decision branches. K10 preserves conditional trial documentation, not a complete trial-effect inquiry. The narrower contribution remains subject to reliable-linkage conditions and does not establish observed explanations or aggregate effects.
core_failure_explanation: No core failure: definite viable source-derived remainders survive.
